    We calculate the Thiel voltage shift, which is a measure to account for device variation.
    This is a parameter that will be determined from the experimental data.
    """
    Thiel_shift = parameters[0]
    
    Vt_gs = Thiel_shift + parameters[1] * gate_voltage_abs
    Vt_ds = Thiel_shift + parameters[2] * drain_voltage_abs
    
    """
    Section 2: Expresses the exponent using the Thiel voltage shifts and voltage differences.
    Logic behind log((Vgs - Vt_gs)^2 / (Vds - Vt_ds))
    The log function is used to represent the sublinear behavior of the current with larger gate and drain voltages.
    The term (Vgs - Vt_gs)^2 captures the quadratic relationship between the gate voltage and the current.
    The term (Vds - Vt_ds) ensures the proper orientation of the curve, as the log function produces positive values.
    """
